Action point
5
Shri Nagaraju Maddirala, IAS, Secretary , DFS, Government of India advised SIDBI, EXIM Bank and NABARD to promote and establish FPO’s in Narasapur of  West Godavari district.
SIDBI is engaged in promotion and capacity building of FPOs having non-farm value addition  for the clusters viz., Coconut based, Coir based and Lace in Narsapur, West Godavari.  Micro Enterprises Promotion Programme of SIDBI is an initiative to promote enterprises leading to employment generation in rural/semi-urban, artisans-based by facilitating business services  availability through its designated agency viz., MEPDA at Rajamahendravaram and adjoining districts. Now, the initiative is taken forth towards the FPOs in Narasapur.
EXIM Bank extended support to 200 artisans affiliated with Lace Artisans' Federation in Narsapur, known for its intricate crochet lace craftsmanship. The Bank organised skill enhancement workshops on traditional crochet lace techniques. Additionally, handholding and mentoring sessions were conducted in collaboration with Apparel Training & Design Centre, to improve design sensibilities and production quality. Hands-on training on Juki machines was provided to introduce artisans to modern stitching equipment and improve efficiency. Going forward Bank shall promote & support FPO’s in the region. 
NABARD: One FPO (Narasapuram FPCL) is already functioning in Narasapuram mandal, established under CSS of GoI for the formation of 10k FPOs with NABARD as implementing agency and National Agro Foundation as CBBO, with total 750 farmers as members. The FPO was registered in FY 22-23. The primary commodity is Coconut  with a reported turn over of ₹31.75 lakh for FY 23-24. The FPO is onboarded into online market platforms like ONDC, GeM etc and exploring avenues for value addition. Availed   ₹9.00 lakh from UBI for establishment of Coconut Processing Unit.

7
Stressed that digital security must go beyond basics, advocating for adoption of Quantum safe cryptography
Banks informed, they are sanctioning loans to all eligible entrepreneurs, and ready to extend MSME loans to all women ready to establish units. Banks also conducting outreach program and launching different schemes for financing MSME
SLBC wrote to all Banks with a request to provide timely credit to achieve Hon'ble Chief Minister goal of one family - one entrepreneur and requested Banks to lend liberally to all eligible women to achieve 1 lakh women entrepreneurs by 08.03.26.  76,000 Women Entrepreneurs created in line with the Mission.
Banks informed ,they are covering all eligible customers with digital products through digi district program and encouraging customers to use digital channels and promoting RBI’s CBDC to increase digital transactions
Banks informed, they escalated the matter to their corporate offices regarding quantum safe digital transaction and ensured to interact with hubs established under National quantum mission to leverage their expertise
Banks acknowledged the importance of digital security and escalated the matter to their  Central offices for adoption of quantum - safe cryptography to ensure robust protection against emerging threats.

The State Government has framed the policy of “one family-one entrepreneur” to empower every family through entrepreneurship. Banks were requested to provide working capital and term loans under Central and State Government sponsored schemes and extend full support to young entrepreneurs and start-ups.
He stated that Women empowerment is a major focus of Govt and informed that State Government plans to make 1 lakh women entrepreneurs by 08.03.26 (International Women’s Day).  He requested Banks to provide full support through timely credit.
Requested Banks to come out with  clear action plan, along with specific targets to enhance digital transactions as a percentage of overall transactions.
Advised Banks to constitute a working committee to prepare a road map for migration to quantum safe digital transactions by studying various global practices and interacting with various hubs established under the national quantum mission.
